summary: fix: live stream buffers carry the engine's history window after a provider restart and for late subscriptions (audit 2026-10-05 C11-01)
risks: 2 organism file(s) changed — replay verification required

Frozen decision surface changed (owner sign-off 2026-10-05): phase2_freeze --verify --candidate reports data_pipeline_sources.streaming_data_provider and data_pipeline_sources.live_engine_data in addition to the base branch's source_hashes.entry_gates_dispatch and research_policy_sources.broker_state_safety; production needs a regenerated candidate_param_freeze.json and a new approved activation (new FROZEN_AT resets the forward clock).

tests/test_phase2_freeze.py::test_decision_surface_unchanged and ::test_verify_mode_passes_on_unchanged_surface fail by design until the release assembly regenerates candidate_param_freeze.json (deliberately not regenerated on this branch).

Live data-path behaviour changes after a provider restart and for symbols subscribed after startup (scanner window, newly held names): features, regime and scans use the engine's 500-bar window (481 feature rows) instead of a 50-499-bar buffer, so those names are no longer skipped by the alpha/breakout row gates and regime routing matches a normally started engine and replay. Normal startup, transport reconnects and stale-stream reconnects are unchanged.

If the REST seed already holds the newest closed bar when the stream delivers it, that stream bar is a same-minute correction and the symbol's first live receipt waits for the next bar (up to one more minute excluded from entries; fail-closed, the same race as the existing startup prefill).
Extra REST only while seeds fail: one seed retry per failing symbol per 60 s (<= 28/min) and <= 5 short-buffer reads per 10 s (<= 30/min, each <= 5 s, at most one parallel round per tick).
follow_ups: Release assembly: regenerate artifacts/phase2/candidate_param_freeze.json once for all frozen-code fixes, then activate (new FROZEN_AT, activation record, daily-evidence binding) together with the SCANNER_ENABLED flip.
Optional (verifier: low priority, 3-8 s measured): move the startup prefill out of STARTUP_TIMEOUT_S and let the background seed fill it after subscriptions are confirmed.
C11-05: the feature store's QA report is computed and discarded every tick and its 19-row warm-up trim still applies (non-surface part can land separately).
diagnostic_checks.check_streaming_coverage counts REST-seeded buffers as streaming coverage (C14 note); seeds now also fill buffers after restarts and for late subscriptions.
Add tests/test_audit_20261005_surface_stream_history.py to the paper-readiness workflow selection.
